description: This Java source file defines the JobServices class, which provides static methods for managing background job operations such as canceling jobs, retry management, purging old jobs, and resetting job states within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: JobServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for job management operations such as canceling, retry management, purging, and resetting jobs within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Cancels a job identified by jobId, updates its status and cancel timestamp, and returns the result.

methods.name: cancelJobRetries
methods.description: Resets the maximum retry count for a specified job, with permission check.

methods.name: purgeOldJobs
methods.description: Removes jobs older than a specified number of days from the job queue.

methods.name: resetJob
methods.description: Resets the status and timestamps of a specified job to pending state.
